CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `discovered_djs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `instagramUsername` varchar(255),
  `soundcloudUsername` varchar(255),
  `fullName` varchar(255),
  `email` varchar(255),
  `instagramFollowers` int,
  `instagramPostsCount` int,
  `instagramAvgLikes` decimal(10,2),
  `instagramAvgComments` decimal(10,2),
  `instagramEngagementRate` decimal(5,4),
  `instagramPostsPerWeek` decimal(5,2),
  `soundcloudFollowers` int,
  `soundcloudTracksCount` int,
  `soundcloudTotalPlays` bigint,
  `soundcloudAvgLikes` decimal(10,2),
  `soundcloudAvgReposts` decimal(10,2),
  `soundcloudEngagementRate` decimal(5,4),
  `soundcloudUploadsPerMonth` decimal(5,2),
  `talentScore` decimal(5,2),
  `engagementScore` decimal(5,2),
  `growthScore` decimal(5,2),
  `consistencyScore` decimal(5,2),
  `reachScore` decimal(5,2),
  `genreMatchScore` decimal(5,2),
  `primaryGenre` varchar(100),
  `secondaryGenres` json,
  `discoveryStatus` enum('discovered','qualified','contacted','responded','converted','rejected','dormant') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'discovered',
  `discoveryDate` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `lastUpdated` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `lastScraped` timestamp,
  `bio` text,
  `profileImageUrl` text,
  `instagramUrl` text,
  `soundcloudUrl` text,
  `aiNotes` text,
  CONSTRAINT `discovered_djs_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `usernames_idx` (`instagramUsername`, `soundcloudUsername`),
  KEY `talent_score_idx` (`talentScore`),
  KEY `discovery_status_idx` (`discoveryStatus`),
  KEY `primary_genre_idx` (`primaryGenre`),
  KEY `discovery_date_idx` (`discoveryDate`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `scout_metrics` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `djId` int NOT NULL,
  `instagramFollowers` int,
  `soundcloudFollowers` int,
  `instagramEngagementRate` decimal(5,4),
  `soundcloudEngagementRate` decimal(5,4),
  `recordedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `scout_metrics_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  KEY `dj_recorded_idx` (`djId`, `recordedAt`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `agent_config` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `agentName` enum('scout','closer','monetizer') NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `enabled` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `config` json,
  `lastRunAt` timestamp,
  `lastRunStatus` enum('success','failed','running'),
  `lastRunError` text,
  `totalRuns` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `successfulRuns` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `failedRuns` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `agent_config_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
